scene pumpkin
scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello1
The party begins the way it always begins — at the beginning! But is the beginning the end this time? Find out soon! Halloween!
lines.zh: 派对一如既往地开始——从开头开始！但这一次，开头会不会就是结尾？答案即将揭晓！万圣节！

lines.en: : Well, we made it! Sure, there was a little drama along the way. And sure, we’re a tiny bit fashionably late at this point...but we’re here! And that’s more than Ami and Maya can say.
lines.zh: : 好啦，我们到了！虽说路上出了点小状况。虽说我们现在算是有那么一点点……时髦地迟到了……但我们到了！这可比 Ami 和 Maya 强多了。

lines.en: : Should we maybe...call Ami and see if...she was ever able to find Maya? Or are we just...ignoring their existence for the rest of the night?...
lines.zh: : 我们要不要……给 Ami 打个电话，看……她到底有没有找到 Maya？还是说我们就……整晚当她们不存在？……

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello2

: What do you think, Sensei? Should we let the two of them have whatever sort of emotional moment they’re having behind the scenes to themselves? Or is it time to finally check in and see if they’re okay?
lines.zh: : 你说呢，Sensei？我们要不要把属于她们俩的那段情感时刻留给她们自己？还是说该去看看她们是否安好？

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello3
: Darn it. We’ve lost him again.
lines.zh: : 糟糕。我们又把他弄丢了。

lines.en: : I’d say he looks upset but...I think that’s just his default expression...
lines.zh: : 我想说他看起来很失落，不过……我觉得那就是他的默认表情……

lines.en: : I’m still here, you two. And it doesn’t really matter to me whether or not one of them is okay. I’m just worried about whether Ami is going to make it here or not.
lines.zh: : 我还在这儿，你们俩。而且她们中谁好不好，对我来说其实都不重要。我只是担心 Ami 到底能不能到这儿来。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello4
: But if she does, then you’ll just swap to being worried about how she is here. Also, that’s mean to Maya. Even if she isn’t our Maya.
lines.zh: : 可她要是来了，你又会转而担心她在这儿的状态。还有，那样对 Maya 很刻薄。就算她不是我们的那个 Maya。

lines.en: : Is there...a second Maya?...
lines.zh: : 有……第二个 Maya 吗？……

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello5
: There used to be. She went on vacation to a different time-
lines.zh: : 以前有。她去另一个时间度假了——

lines.en: : Is there...a second Maya?...
lines.zh: : 有……第二个 Maya 吗？……

lines.en: : Some stuff happened with the end of the world where-
lines.zh: : 世界末日那会儿发生了一些事，就是——

lines.en: : Is there...a second Maya?...
lines.zh: : 有……第二个 Maya 吗？……

lines.en: : There’s probably even more than that when you factor in how time itself keeps being-
lines.zh: : 要是把时间本身不断被——这个因素也算上的话，搞不好还不止两个呢

lines.en: : Is there...a second Maya?...
lines.zh: : 有……第二个 Maya 吗？……

lines.en: : Ayane, knock it off. You’re going to break Sana.
lines.zh: : Ayane，别闹了。你会把 Sana 搞坏的。

lines.en: : What?...
: It’s just so weird. I keep feeling like we already talked to her about this stuff, but I have no idea how since she keeps turning into a robot any time I try.
lines.zh: : 真奇怪。我总感觉我们已经跟她聊过这些事了，可我完全想不通是怎么办到的，因为我每次一开口她就变成机器人。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello6
: Or maybe she is a robot and it’s not Sana beneath that mask at all! Show yourself, you coward!
lines.zh: : 或者她本来就是机器人，那张面具底下根本不是 Sana！出来吧，你这个胆小鬼！

lines.en: And so begins another Halloween...but to say I’m at all excited about that would be nothing short of the greatest lie ever told since the last one marked the real end of the world as far as I’m concerned.
lines.zh: 于是又一个万圣节开始了……但要说我对此有半点期待，那简直是继上一次之后人类撒过的最大谎言——对我来说，那次才是世界真正的终结。

lines.en: Everything that has happened since then has felt like some sort of tragic epilogue designed to drag me through the mud and beat me until I can no longer move.
lines.zh: 自那以后发生的一切都像某种悲惨的尾声，专门为了把我拖进泥里、打到我再也动不了为止。

lines.en: It’s worked too. Which is why I find myself struggling to redirect my blood flow the way I always do when I walk into a room full of girls in cosplay.
lines.zh: 它也确实成功了。所以当我走进一间满是 cosplay 女生的房间时，我发现自己很难像往常那样把血液调往该去的地方。

lines.en: Can I find it in myself to actually have fun this year, though?
lines.zh: 不过，今年我还能不能真的玩得开心？

lines.en: Because seeing Maya like that earlier, even if she wasn’t Maya, has undoubtedly made it harder for me to keep my head on straight today.
lines.zh: 因为刚才看到 Maya 那个样子——哪怕那不是 Maya——无疑让我今天更难保持清醒。

lines.en: So the question now is whether I will be able to look past that toward shades of the older me.
lines.zh: 所以现在的问题是，我能不能越过这一点，去望向旧日我的影子。

lines.en: I can picture it when I close my eyes. I’m not smiling, but I’m present. And that’s far more than whatever I am now. Because at least there were others around back then to make up for what I lack.
lines.zh: 我闭上眼就能勾勒出来。我没有在笑，但我在场。那已经远远胜过现在的我。因为至少那时候身边还有别人，来弥补我所缺的东西。

lines.en: And yes, those people still exist today. But I’ve already stolen everything from everyone and there’s just...nothing left for me to fill the void with anymore.
lines.zh: 是的，那些人今天依然存在。但我已经把所有人的一切都偷走了，已经……没有任何东西能让我填补那片空洞了。

lines.en: So I ask myself again — can I really do this?
lines.zh: 所以我再一次问自己——我真的能做到吗？

lines.en: Can I ignore the past and live in the present- even if it’s just for one night?
lines.zh: 我能无视过去、活在当下吗——哪怕只是一个晚上？

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello7
: And there he is! Welcome back to the land of the living, Master!
lines.zh: : 他来了！欢迎回到活人的世界，Master！

lines.en: The answer is no. No I can not.
lines.zh: 答案是不能。不能，我做不到。

lines.en: : Hey, Uta. Hey...Io.
lines.zh: : 嘿，Uta。嘿……Io。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello8
: Hi...Sensei.
lines.zh: : 嗨……Sensei。

lines.en: : A few of us were beginning to worry you were gonna back outta the party this year. Which would’ve been a real disaster since we’ve all been dying to see you.
lines.zh: : 我们几个还开始担心你今年会不会干脆不来派对了呢。那可真是场灾难，毕竟我们大家都想死你了。

lines.en: scene rememberme26
scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello9
scene rememberme26
scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello9
scene rememberme26
scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello8
: Yeah, well...it’s nice being back.
lines.zh: : 是啊，嗯……回来挺好的。

lines.en: The second greatest lie ever told.
lines.zh: 史上第二大谎言。

lines.en: : Don’t think that means I’m planning on coming back to school yet, though. I need...a lot more time before I even consider something like that.
lines.zh: : 不过别以为这就意味着我打算回学校了。我还需要……很多时间，才会考虑那种事。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello10
: You mean you’re just gonna let Ami come back to school without supervision? You sure that’s safe for...literally anybody?
lines.zh: : 你是说你就这么让 Ami 在没人看着的情况下回学校？你确定那对……字面意义上的任何人……都安全吗？

lines.en: : Why did you immediately start blushing after mentioning Ami’s name?
lines.zh: : 为什么你一提到 Ami 的名字就开始脸红？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. That’s probably going to happen for a while.
lines.zh: : 别在意。这种状况大概会持续一阵子。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello11
: F...Forget about Ami! Io! Don’t you wanna express a little more excitement now that Sensei’s coming to our parties again? He was like 50%% of the reason you ever bothered showing up, wasn’t he?
lines.zh: : 别、别管 Ami 了！Io！Sensei 又开始来我们的派对了，你就不想表现得兴奋一点吗？他大概有 50%% 是你以前愿意来的原因吧？

lines.en: : Yeah...I’m...glad he’s...you’re back.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我……很高兴他……你回来了。

lines.en: : That’s...exciting.
lines.zh: : 那挺……让人兴奋的。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello12
: I feel like you’re normally a little more enthusiastic than that...
lines.zh: : 我觉得你平时应该比这更热情一点吧……

lines.en: : Sensei! Sana and I are gonna go sit down. But we’ll let you know if we hear anything from Ami.
lines.zh: : Sensei！我和 Sana 要去坐一会儿。不过 Ami 那边一有消息我们就告诉你。

lines.en: : Huh? Oh, yeah. Okay. Cool.
lines.zh: : 嗯？哦，好。行。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello13
I’m abandoned by my chaperones — two of the only girls in this room who do a consistent job of making me feel human (even if one of them is still new to the trade).
lines.zh: 我被我的两位监护人抛弃了——这屋里仅有的、能持续让我觉得自己像个人的两个女孩（尽管其中一个还是新手）。

lines.en: But of course that leaves me with two who don’t.
lines.zh: 但那当然就剩下两个做不到的了。

lines.en: There’s one who accentuates everything evil within me. One who I have seen in ways that aren’t meant to be seen. Who I think about when I’m at my highest and lowest.
lines.zh: 其中一个放大了我内心所有的恶。我以不该被看见的方式见过她。我在最高潮与最低谷时想到的都是她。

lines.en: And another — who I struggle to see at all after our last meeting.
lines.zh: 而另一个——上次见面之后，我几乎无法正视她。

lines.en: : So, what’s the plan for today? Gonna walk around and do some of that good ole’ Sensei mingling you always do at these things? We should probably start bringing a sign-up sheet for that, shouldn’t-
lines.zh: : 那么，今天有什么计划？打算像你以前在这些场合那样走来走去、搞一搞你那套拿手的 Sensei 式社交吗？我们大概该为此准备个报名表了吧，不是吗——

lines.en: : Uta, I’m really sorry to interrupt. But would it be okay if I talked to Sensei alone for a minute?
lines.zh: : Uta，很抱歉打断你。但我能单独和 Sensei 谈一会儿吗？

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello14
: Huh? Yeah, of course. It’s not like I own him. It’s probably closer to the other way around after all of the money he’s given me. Is everything okay, though?
lines.zh: : 哈？当然可以。他又不是我的专属物。而且他给了我那么多钱，说起来可能更像是我属于他。不过你还好吗？

lines.en: : No. Not really. But nothing’s ever really okay and in order to stop everything from becoming even more terrible, I sort of have to talk to him. Alone. Now.
lines.zh: : 不好。真的不好。但从来就没有真正好过，而为了不让一切变得更糟，我必须得跟他谈谈。单独。现在。

lines.en: : Uh...Do you...need any of your...medicine? Because my bag is-
lines.zh: : 呃……你……需要吃点你的……药吗？因为我的包里——

lines.en: : We’ll see...
lines.zh: : 到时候再说吧……

lines.en: scene black
: Sensei...I know it’s probably exhausting already being dragged into my bullshit five seconds after you showed up, but-
lines.zh: : Sensei……我知道你刚到五秒钟就被我这些破事拽进来大概很累，不过——

lines.en: : It’s fine...
lines.zh: : 没事……

lines.en: : Okay...sorry.
lines.zh: : 好……抱歉。

lines.en: : I think there’s a room over there we can-
lines.zh: : 我觉得那边有个房间我们可以——

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello15
: Aaaand the winner is Io. Good game, everyone. See you next holiday.
lines.zh: : 那么，获胜者是 Io。大家辛苦了，下次节日再见。

lines.en: : Uh...winner?
lines.zh: : 呃……获胜者？

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello16
: Yeah. Every single party, there’s always one girl who gets to spend alone time with Sensei first.
lines.zh: : 对。每一场派对，总会有一个女生能第一个和 Sensei 独处。

lines.en: : So I decided to turn it into a game in order to cope with the fact that there will always be other girls fighting for him and that his heart will never truly belong to me no matter what I do.
lines.zh: : 所以我把它变成了一个游戏，好让自己接受这个事实——永远都会有别的女生为他争抢，而无论我做什么，他的心都不会真正属于我。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello17
: But hey! You also love him now so that just means you get to play too!
lines.zh: : 不过嘿！现在你也喜欢他了，所以你也可以一起玩！

lines.en: : Why not just...take first place yourself then?
lines.zh: : 那你自己为什么不干脆……拿个第一？

lines.en: : Because there are designated times where I’m allowed to be selfish and this is not one of them. Duh.
lines.zh: : 因为有某些时候是允许我自私的，而现在不是其中之一。这不是明摆着嘛。

lines.en: : So...do you think they’re, like...you know...
lines.zh: : 那……你觉得她们会，那个……你懂的……

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello18
: Mmmmm...no. But I am not willing to divulge why I think that. I guess something could have changed, though. But to the point where it’s happening five seconds into a party? Nah. Not yet.
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯……不会。但我不想说我是怎么得出这个结论的。不过也可能有什么变了。但要到「派对刚开始五秒就发生」的程度？不会。还没到。
: 我……明白了……

lines.en: : Oh well. At least now you know about the game and can start racking up points of your own. You’ve been getting more bold lately, so there’s still a good chance you can catch up.
lines.zh: : 算了。至少现在你知道这个游戏了，可以开始攒你自己的分了。你最近越来越大胆了，所以追上来还是很有希望的。

lines.en: : Ayane...how are you...this good at dealing with jealousy?
lines.zh: : Ayane……你是怎么……这么擅长应对嫉妒的？

lines.en: : It’s not like I want to be. I’m just used to it. And the sad truth is that you’re going to get used to it too the longer you stay with him. But as long as you’re not doing anything rash-
lines.zh: : 我又不是想这样。我只是习惯了。而可悲的事实是，你跟他在一起越久，也会习惯的。但只要你别做什么冲动的事——

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello19
: I broke a glass and gave him a blowjob at the bar when he came in with Miss Imai the other night.
lines.zh: : 前几天晚上他和 Imai 老师来酒吧的时候，我砸碎了一个杯子，还给他口了。

lines.en: : I think I have a problem, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我有问题，Ayane。

lines.en: : I think I want to pretend I didn’t just hear that.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我想假装我刚才没听见。

lines.en: : I don’t even think he wanted one.
lines.zh: : 我甚至觉得他根本不想要。

lines.en: : Why are you still talking about this?
lines.zh: : 你为什么还在说这个？

lines.en: : He didn’t even cum that much.
lines.zh: : 他射得也没那么多。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello20
: Sana, stop! You’re ruining your appeal!
lines.zh: : Sana，住口！你在毁掉你的魅力！

lines.en: : Sorry, I just...don’t have anyone else to talk to about this...
lines.zh: : 抱歉，我只是……没有别人可以说这些……

lines.en: : That’s fine! But that doesn’t mean you need to start providing the specific details of how much he cums when you give him spontaneous blowjobs!
lines.zh: : 那没关系！但这不代表你需要把「你突然给他口的时候他射了多少」的细节都交代出来！

lines.en: : But what if he does it more for other girls? I’m not as good with jealousy as you are...
lines.zh: : 可要是他对别的女生射得更多呢？我可没有你那么会处理嫉妒……

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello21
: N-New subject! How have things been apart from your quest for Sensei lately? Has business at the bar picked back up? Did you finish all of your math homework?
lines.zh: : 换、换话题！除了追求 Sensei 之外你最近怎么样？酒吧的生意回升了吗？数学作业都写完了吗？

lines.en: : No. But I had a really intense daydream about my brother the other night.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过前几天晚上我做了一个特别强烈的白日梦，梦到我哥。

lines.en: : Intense...how? And please tell me it won’t further tarnish your image.
lines.zh: : 强烈……怎么个强烈法？拜托告诉我那不会进一步玷污你的形象。

lines.en: : He tried to give me a tour of a liminal space but wasn’t ever able to because I pulled all of the knives out of him. Then he turned into Sensei as a kid and Kaori showed up. Also, I think God was there.
lines.zh: : 他试图带我参观一个阈限空间，但一直没能成功，因为我把他身上所有的刀都拔了出来。然后他变成了小时候的 Sensei，Kaori 也出现了。还有，我觉得 God 也在场。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello22
: What did Sensei look like as a kid? I must know.
lines.zh: : Sensei 小时候长什么样？我必须知道。

lines.en: : Very cute. Maybe even a little feminine. I tried flirting with him but it didn’t work.
lines.zh: : 非常可爱。甚至有点女性化。我试着勾引他，但没成功。

lines.en: : I don’t blame you. I would have done the same thing.
lines.zh: : 我不怪你。换我也会这么做。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello23
: Your brother, though? That’s weird for you, isn’t it? I didn’t realize he ever showed up in your dreams.
lines.zh: : 不过你哥？这对你来说很奇怪吧？我不知道他还会出现在你梦里。

lines.en: : That’s why it was weird...It just kind of...happened out of nowhere. Like, I was walking home and...all of a sudden, there was a...thing that tickled trees and...Sensei could fly and...
lines.zh: : 所以说才奇怪……它就是那么……凭空发生的。就像，我走在回家的路上，然后……突然出现了一个……会挠树的东西，还有……Sensei 会飞，还有……

lines.en: : I’ve been seeing all sorts of weird things lately, Ayane. I’m starting to think I’m going insane.
lines.zh: : 我最近看到了各种各样的怪事，Ayane。我开始觉得自己要疯了。

lines.en: : By any chance, did you see a strange creature with a giant penis and a red shirt that called himself “Big Boi?”
lines.zh: : 顺便问一句，你有没有看到一只长着巨大阴茎、穿着红衬衫、自称「Big Boi」的奇怪生物？

lines.en: : No, but I wouldn’t rule out that he’ll show up at some point since I guess this is just my life now.
lines.zh: : 没有，但我也不会排除他哪天会出现——毕竟这大概就是我现在的日常了。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello24
: Well, if you do, let me know...Because I’ve been seeing a lot of weird things too. So it takes a lot more than that for me to think someone is crazy nowadays.
lines.zh: : 好吧，要是你看到了，告诉我一声……因为我也看到了很多怪东西。所以现在要让我觉得谁疯了，可得比这严重得多。

lines.en: : Maybe we’re...both going crazy?
lines.zh: : 也许我们……都在变疯？

lines.en: : Or maybe it’s the world we live-
lines.zh: : 或者也许是我们生活的这个世——

lines.en: : Maybe we’re...both going crazy?
lines.zh: : 也许我们……都在变疯？

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello25
: Damn it! That too?! I barely even said anything!
lines.zh: : 该死！这也来？！我明明都没说什么！

lines.en: : Wh-Why are you yelling at me?! I barely said anything either!
lines.zh: : 你、你为什么冲我吼？！我也没说什么啊！

lines.en: scene black
: I know! That’s the whole problem! There’s a bunch of stuff I want to tell you but literally can’t because of extenuating circumstances that-
lines.zh: : 我知道！问题就在这儿！有一大堆事我想告诉你，却因为各种外部状况根本说不出口——

lines.en: : Wh-Why are you yelling at me?! I barely said anything either!
lines.zh: : 你、你为什么冲我吼？！我也没说什么啊！

lines.en: : ARGGGGGGHH!!!!!!!
lines.zh: : 啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

lines.en: They were entirely sane, they were mad and delusional, they were the best of friends, they were mortal enemies, they were immeasurably happy, they were deeply depressed.
lines.zh: 她们完全清醒，她们疯狂而妄想，她们是最好的朋友，她们是不共戴天的仇敌，她们无比幸福，她们深陷抑郁。

lines.en: But more than all of that...they were-
lines.zh: 但比这一切更重要的是……她们是——

lines.en: scene rainking
scene black
scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello26
Empty hearts are hard to break. That’s something I have learned-
lines.zh: 空心的心很难被打碎。这是我在——学到的

lines.en: On walks down to my mother’s lake. Mistakes are made, not earned.
lines.zh: 走下母亲那片湖的路上。错误是犯下的，不是挣来的。

lines.en: Through joy and pleasure, wind and rain, this fear of something new-
lines.zh: 穿过喜悦与欢愉、风与雨，这份对未知之物的恐惧——

lines.en: I won’t ever see the point of pain, nor love received from you.
lines.zh: 我永远不会明白痛苦的意义，也不明白从你那里得到的爱。

lines.en: Of all the rooms in this infinite house, this is the one she chooses.
lines.zh: 这栋无限大的房子里有那么多房间，她偏偏选了这一间。

lines.en: She knows not its significance, nor the way it makes me feel. She knows nothing of the pain or dread that accompanies that orange glow or how it paints her in a way that accentuates her cracks.
lines.zh: 她不知道它的意义，也不知道它让我作何感受。她对那橘色光芒所伴随的痛苦与恐惧一无所知，也不知道它如何描绘她、凸显出她的裂痕。

lines.en: She knows nothing at all.
lines.zh: 她什么都不知道。

lines.en: She looks like me in the light.
lines.zh: 在这光里，她看起来像我。

lines.en: if iosex == True:
: So, I’ve...had time to think about what happened, and...
lines.zh: : 那，我……有时间想了想发生的事，然后……

lines.en: : I want you to know I...
lines.zh: : 我想让你知道我……

lines.en: : I don’t blame you, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我不怪你，Sensei……

lines.en: : If you...even feel bad about it, I mean. Which you might not. I know you’ve said before that that’s just...how you love. And that...makes me really happy. Or...happy-ish, I guess.
lines.zh: : 如果你……真的为此感到愧疚的话。当然你可能并不觉得。我知道你以前说过，那只是……你爱的方式。而那……让我很开心。或者说……算是开心吧。

lines.en: : Maybe more...bittersweet than anything. Like, I want to drown in the mere thought that someone like me could ever mean so much to you, but there’s something about it I just...don’t really get.
lines.zh: : 也许更多的是……苦乐参半。就像，光是想到像我这样的人对你来说能那么重要，我就想沉溺其中，可其中有些东西我就是……不太明白。

lines.en: : And that’s a me thing. It’s always been a me thing. And I’m not good when it comes to, like...sacrificing stuff, you know?
lines.zh: : 而那是我自己的问题。一直都是我自己的问题。而且我不太擅长，比如说……牺牲，你懂吗？

lines.en: : I have so little that the few things I do have, I can’t help but cling to for dear life because I don’t want to ever be completely alone.
lines.zh: : 我拥有的太少了，所以仅有的那几样东西，我忍不住要死死抓住，因为我不想彻底孤身一人。

lines.en: : Is that what you’re doing now then?
lines.zh: : 那你现在就是在做这件事吗？

lines.en: : Yeah...it is. It’s what I did back in my room too.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是的。我在房间里那次也是这样。

lines.en: : I thought that just escaping from my old home would make it so I could finally have my own body for once, but...not sharing it with someone you’re falling in love with does nothing but break the fall.
lines.zh: : 我原以为只要逃离那个老家，我就能终于拥有属于自己的身体，可是……不把身体与一个你正在爱上的人分享，除了缓冲坠落之外毫无作用。

lines.en: : So you can have it...whenever you want. Even now if you feel like it. And I’ll try not to be so...impatient this time.
lines.zh: : 所以你可以随时拥有它……只要你想要。就算现在也行。而我会尽量不那么……急躁。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello27
: I just...want to ask for something selfish in return. I want you to really fall for me. Like...hard.
lines.zh: : 我只是……想自私地要一样东西作为回报。我想让你真的爱上我。就是……很深很深地。

lines.en: : I want to finish school, break down that stupid fucking wall, and build a house with you somewhere no one can bother me anymore.
lines.zh: : 我想念完书，拆掉那堵该死的墙，然后和你在某个没人能打扰我的地方盖一座房子。

lines.en: : I want a quiet life where I feel safe because that is the only possible way I can counteract the way opening myself up feels. I can’t shake that, Sensei. I will never shake that.
lines.zh: : 我想要一种安静的、让我有安全感的生活，因为那是唯一能抵消「敞开心扉」所带来的感受的方式。我甩不掉这个，Sensei。我永远甩不掉。

lines.en: : But if it’s you...and you really really love me...I’ll let it happen.
lines.zh: : 但如果是你……如果你真的、真的很爱我……我愿意让它发生。

lines.en: : I don’t just want you to let it happen, though...
lines.zh: : 可我不想让你只是「让它发生」……

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello28
: Neither do I, obviously! Do you know how much easier this would be if I could separate myself from all the fear and pain I associate with sex? I’d be a whole new girl.
lines.zh: : 我也不想啊，废话！你知道如果我能把那些和性绑在一起的恐惧和痛苦剥离出去，这一切会容易多少吗？我会变成一个全新的人。

lines.en: : I’d be someone who could give you everything you wanted instead of a bunch of stuff you don’t want. And I’m sorry about that.
lines.zh: : 我会变成一个能给你一切你想要的东西的人，而不是一堆你不想要的。对此我很抱歉。

lines.en: : I’m sorry you have to search for reasons to love me. I’m sorry that it wound up being me at all if...if what you were saying was even true back there and not just a lie you were using to try and fuck me.
lines.zh: : 我很抱歉你不得不去找爱我的理由。我很抱歉那个对象最后是我——如果……如果你当时在那儿说的那些话是真的，而不只是用来骗我上床的谎言。

lines.en: : Do you really think I’d lie about that, Io?
lines.zh: : 你真的觉得我会拿那种事撒谎吗，Io？

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello29
: Yes.
: Just saying you love someone doesn’t mean it’s true. Because I’ve heard that ten million times and 99%% of those times were during the worst, most terrifying moments of my life.
lines.zh: : 光是说爱一个人并不代表那就是真的。因为这句话我听过一千万次，其中 99%% 都出现在我人生中最糟、最可怕的时刻。

lines.en: : But I still believe in love despite that. I want this to be true. I just have no idea how to convince myself it is because I don’t know how love is supposed to look.
lines.zh: : 但即便如此我依然相信爱。我希望这是真的。我只是不知道该怎么说服自己，因为我不知道爱应该长什么样。

lines.en: : You have an idea of that already. You’ve made up your mind on how love is supposed to be and feel and you shared that with me- but that didn’t feel like love to me, Sensei. So what am I supposed to do?
lines.zh: : 你已经有了想法。你已经认定了爱应该是什么样、什么感觉，并且告诉了我——可那对我来说并不像爱，Sensei。那我该怎么办？

lines.en: : How am I ever supposed to love anyone without getting a stomachache? Can I just knock myself out first? Would that do the trick? I have no idea where to go from here. I just...
lines.zh: : 我要怎么才能爱一个人而不胃痛？我能先把自己打晕吗？那样管用吗？我不知道该从哪儿走下去。我只是……

lines.en: : I know that I don’t want you to go away.
lines.zh: : 我只知道我不想让你离开。

lines.en: : You really hated it that much, huh?...
lines.zh: : 你真的那么讨厌那件事吗？……

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello30
: Please don’t enable me to talk even more about how that made me feel when it’s a miracle you still like me in the first place.
lines.zh: : 拜托别再让我继续说那让我有多难受了——你还喜欢我本身就是个奇迹了。

lines.en: : I don’t want to make those feelings dwindle even more than I’m sure they already have.
lines.zh: : 我不想让那些感情变得比现在更淡。

lines.en: : Nothing’s dwindled, Io. I feel the same about you now that I did back then. And I wish I was different too.
lines.zh: : 什么都没有变淡，Io。我现在对你的感觉和当时一样。我也希望我能不一样。

lines.en: : I can try, though. If you really hate it, I can try.
lines.zh: : 但我可以试试。如果你真的那么讨厌，我可以试试。

lines.en: : No, because then that just makes me feel like you’re suffering for my sake and that sucks too. Just...
lines.zh: : 不，因为那样只会让我觉得你是在为了我受苦，那也很糟。只是……

lines.en: : I don’t know, Sensei. Maybe everything just felt worse back then because of what led into it. And while I’m not going to take back any of what I said, I do want to apologize for...how I said it.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，Sensei。也许那时候一切都感觉更糟，是因为之前发生的事铺垫了它。虽然我不会收回我说过的任何话，但我想为……我说的方式道歉。

lines.en: : It’s just...that’s a...touchy subject for me.
lines.zh: : 只是……那对我来说是个……很敏感的话题。

lines.en: : I would have avoided it altogether if I knew how bad it was beforehand. And I’m sorry too.
lines.zh: : 如果事先知道那么严重，我根本不会碰它。我也很抱歉。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello31
: Did you...enjoy it at least? Is that...okay for me to ask? Because I know I definitely didn’t help. And I can’t imagine finding out you’re playing with a broken toy is very-
lines.zh: : 你……至少享受了吗？我可以问这个吗？因为我知道我肯定没帮上忙。我无法想象发现自己一直在玩一个坏掉的玩具是什么感觉——

lines.en: : You need to stop that, Io.
lines.zh: : 你别再这样了，Io。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello32
: Huh?
scene black
: Saying you’re broken...
lines.zh: : 别再说你坏掉了……

lines.en: else:
: So there’s...not really an easy or...comfortable way for me to say this, but...
lines.zh: : 那……其实没有什么简单或者……舒服的方式能让我说出这句话，不过……

lines.en: : Thank you.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello33
: You have somehow managed to make me like you even more. And if I couldn’t live without you before, I am perpetually fucked now. Just not literally. Which is exactly why I’m saying this.
lines.zh: : 你不知怎么地让我更喜欢你了。如果以前没有你我活不下去，那我现在是彻底完了。只是不是字面意义上的完。所以这正是我说这些的原因。

lines.en: : Uh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: : You left.
lines.zh: : 你走了。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello34
: You treated me like a...like a, like a person. And that...that...like...since I was going to do it and you just...you somehow, like...what?
lines.zh: : 你把我当成……当成一个、当成一个人在对待。而那……那……就是……既然我都要那么做了，而你就……你怎么就……什么？

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello35
: You could have done anything you wanted to me and you did nothing? At all? Did you...think I was going to tell on you? Did you only like me because you thought I was a virgin?
lines.zh: : 你本可以对我做任何你想做的事，而你什么都没做？一点都没有？你是……怕我去告发你吗？你只是因为觉得我是处女才喜欢我吗？

lines.en: : Io-
lines.zh: : Io——

lines.en: : D-Don’t answer that question. Because I don’t want to know if you’re just not interested in me anymore so I can pretend it was something, like...somethiiiiing nice? You still like me, right?
lines.zh: : 别、别回答那个问题。因为我不想知道你是不是已经对我没兴趣了，这样我就可以假装那是某种……某种美好的东西？你还喜欢我，对吧？

lines.en: : Am I just misinterpreting that whole exchange? Are you actually grossed out by me now? Because you should be. And now you’re probably just annoyed that I’m not over you yet or-
lines.zh: : 是我会错意了吗？你现在其实已经觉得我恶心了吗？因为你应该觉得我恶心。而你现在大概只是烦我怎么还没放下你，或者——

lines.en: : Io, of course I’m still interested in you. I just wasn’t about to fuck you in the middle of a mental breakdown.
lines.zh: : Io，我当然对你还有兴趣。我只是不想在你精神崩溃的时候跟你上床。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello36
: Then...oh, okay. You want to do it now? Do I, like...owe you or something? How does this work?
lines.zh: : 那……哦，好吧。你想现在做吗？我是说……我欠你什么的吗？这种事怎么算？

lines.en: : You’re asking if you owe me?
lines.zh: : 你是在问你是不是欠我？

lines.en: : Yeah, like...you just didn’t want to do it in the middle of an episode. But I’m fine now, so we can have sex if you want and you won’t feel guilty.
lines.zh: : 对，就像……你只是不想在发作的时候做。但我现在没事了，所以你想的话我们可以做爱，你也不会有负罪感。

lines.en: : No.
: So you don’t like me anymore then.
lines.zh: : 所以你不再喜欢我了。

lines.en: : Of course I like you.
lines.zh: : 我当然喜欢你。

lines.en: : Just...not sexually?
lines.zh: : 只是……不是性方面的？

lines.en: : I mean, I definitely want to have sex with you.
lines.zh: : 我意思是，我绝对想和你做爱。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello37
: Then why won’t you?! I don’t understand! Did I do something wrong?! Are you phasing me out?! How am I supposed to interpret this, Sensei?!
lines.zh: : 那你为什么不肯？！我不明白！我做错了什么吗？！你在慢慢淘汰我吗？！你让我怎么理解这件事，Sensei？！

lines.en: : I just don’t want to make you do something you don’t want to do, that’s all.
lines.zh: : 我只是不想逼你做你不想做的事，就这样。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello38
: But this...this is like the thing. This is what you want. And you’re just going to deprive yourself of that because of the way I feel?
lines.zh: : 可这……这就是那件事啊。这是你想要的。而你就因为我的感受，打算剥夺自己？

lines.en: : Yeah. That pretty much hits the nail on the head.
lines.zh: : 对。基本就是这么回事。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello39
: Are you an angel?...
lines.zh: : 你是天使吗？……

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : All of my life...I’ve been a tool.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子……一直是个工具。

lines.en: : Am I...
lines.zh: : 我是不是……

lines.en: : Actually free now?
lines.zh: : 现在真的自由了？

lines.en: : Yeah...I guess you are.
lines.zh: : 嗯……我想是的。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello40
: Hah...
: How does it feel — finally being treated like a human after all this time?
lines.zh: : 在这么久之后终于被当成人来对待，是什么感觉？

lines.en: : I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 我不知道……

lines.en: : I’ve never felt like this before.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有过这种感觉。

lines.en: : Just because someone turned you into a tool doesn’t mean you are one, Io.
lines.zh: : 有人把你变成工具，不代表你就是工具，Io。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello41
: Hah...
: I should have paid more attention to all of the hints you gave me. I never should have pressed you about what being a parent means to me. I should have protected you better than that.
lines.zh: : 我应该更留意你给我的所有暗示。我根本不该逼问你「为人父母」对我来说意味着什么。我应该更好地保护你。

lines.en: : Protected me?...
lines.zh: : 保护我？……

lines.en: : I was hanging off the edge of a cliff and you managed to pull me up. You didn’t just protect me...you saved my life. And you didn’t even get anything out of it...
lines.zh: : 我悬在悬崖边上，而你想办法把我拉了上来。你不只是保护了我……你救了我的命。而且你什么都没得到……

lines.en: : I don’t need to get anything. I just...understand what you’ve been through and I don’t want you to hurt any more than you already have.
lines.zh: : 我不需要得到什么。我只是……明白你经历过什么，我不想让你再受更多的伤。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello42
: You’ve suffered more than enough for one lifetime, Io. You can rest now. I’m not going to hurt you.
lines.zh: : 你这辈子受的苦已经够多了，Io。你可以休息了。我不会伤害你。

lines.en: : You...
: Back in my room, you said you went through something just like me, didn’t you? Is that why you can do this? Do you...actually get it?...
lines.zh: : 在我房间里的时候，你说你也经历过和我一样的事，对吧？所以你才能这样？你……真的懂吗？……

lines.en: : Is that...okay for me to ask?
lines.zh: : 这个……我可以问吗？

lines.en: : I internalized my situation a little differently, I think.
lines.zh: : 我想，我把自己的处境内化的方式有点不一样。
: 怎么不一样？……

lines.en: : I’ll let you know whenever I figure that out.
lines.zh: : 等我想明白了再告诉你。

lines.en: : Do you want to get married?
lines.zh: : 你想结婚吗？

lines.en: : Io, come on.
lines.zh: : Io，别闹。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello43

: I mean it, Sensei! Right now! And that’s a huge deal coming from me since I think marriage as a concept is totally archaic and dumb and that putting labels on serious relationships is a recipe for disaster.
lines.zh: : 我是认真的，Sensei！就现在！这对我来说可是件大事，因为我总觉得婚姻这个概念又古老又蠢，给认真的关系贴标签简直是灾难配方。

lines.en: : But I’ll make an exception for you! I’ll do anything for you! And if that’s annoying, then...too bad! I’m not going anywhere! You fed the stray, now take responsibility!
lines.zh: : 但我愿意为你破例！我愿意为你做任何事！如果那很烦人，那就……没办法！我哪儿都不去！你喂了流浪猫，就得负责到底！

lines.en: : This is hardly the time nor the place for a proposal, but I’ll think about it.
lines.zh: : 现在这个时间、这个地点实在不适合求婚，不过我会考虑的。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello44
: Pfft...hahahah!
lines.zh: : 噗……哈哈哈哈！

lines.en: : What the hell did a broken piece of shit like me ever do to deserve a teacher like you?
lines.zh: : 像我这种破烂到底做了什么，能配得上你这样的老师？

lines.en: : Stop that.
lines.zh: : 别这么说。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello45
: Huh?
scene black
: Saying you’re broken.
lines.zh: : 别再说你坏掉了。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello46
: It’s not your fault that any of this happened to you.
lines.zh: : 这一切发生在你身上，不是你的错。

lines.en: : I’m not going to stand here and say shit like “it’s all just a test” or “what doesn’t kill you makes you stronger,” though.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会站在这儿说什么「这都是考验」或者「杀不死你的会让你更强大」之类的屁话。

lines.en: : You were dealt a terrible hand and forced to endure something no one should ever have to endure. I can’t fix that.
lines.zh: : 你拿到了一手烂牌，被迫承受了任何人不该承受的东西。我修不好那个。

lines.en: : And I don’t even like acknowledging it because it makes me feel worse about things that I have done.
lines.zh: : 我甚至不喜欢承认这一点，因为那会让我对自己做过的事感觉更糟。

lines.en: : All I can do is love you. And it might not be the way you want or a way you’re used to, but it’s what I’ll do so long as you want me here.
lines.zh: : 我唯一能做的就是爱你。也许那不是你想要的方式，也不是你习惯的方式，但只要你希望我在这儿，我就会这么做。

lines.en: if iosex == True:
: Do you want me here, though?...
lines.zh: : 那你希望我在这儿吗？……

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure that this is love?...
lines.zh: : 你绝对确定这就是爱吗？……

lines.en: : I’m not sure anything is love when it really comes down to it...but I do know that I want you here.
lines.zh: : 真要说起来的话，我不确定任何东西是爱……但我知道我希望你在这儿。

lines.en: : And I’m sorry that there’s only one way I know how to show you that.
lines.zh: : 而我很抱歉我只会用这一种方式表达。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello47
: Don’t...worry about that. I have...ways of dealing with it.
lines.zh: : 别……担心那个。我有……应对的办法。

lines.en: : I’ll try to make it...less horrible for you in the future, though...
lines.zh: : 不过我会努力让它……以后对你来说没那么糟糕……

lines.en: : But...do know that I’ll be...expecting a lot of cuddling once you’re done.
lines.zh: : 但……你要知道，等你结束之后我会……要求抱很久。

lines.en: : Just maybe not...right away so I can have some time to, like...decompress?
lines.zh: : 只是也许不要……马上，好让我有点时间，就是……缓一缓？

lines.en: : Does that...make sense?
lines.zh: : 这……说得通吗？

lines.en: : Nothing makes sense in this world, Io.
lines.zh: : 这个世界没有一件事说得通，Io。

lines.en: scene black
: It sucks that this had to be the one we were born into.
lines.zh: : 偏偏我们得生在这么一个世界里，真他妈糟。

lines.en: else:
: Of course I want you here. I want to hold you as tight as I can and never let go.
lines.zh: : 我当然希望你在这儿。我想用尽全力抱紧你，再也不放手。

lines.en: : But all that will do is stop me from finding whatever it takes to make you feel even a fragment of the joy I feel when I look at you.
lines.zh: : 但那样只会让我无法找到那个东西——那个能让你感受到哪怕一丝、我看向你时所感受到的喜悦的东西。

lines.en: scene arrivepartyhalloweenhello48
: C...Confusion is still probably the...main emotion I’m feeling right now, though. The joy is still there of course, just...you know...
lines.zh: : 不、不过，困惑大概还是……我现在最主要的情绪。喜悦当然还在，只是……你知道的……

lines.en: : Not every day somebody...decides to not have sex with me.
lines.zh: : 不是每天都有人……决定不和我上床。
